description: Generate a personalized Canton Network developer onboarding/quickstart path. Use when a developer asks how to start building, build a dApp, or develop on Canton specifically. Canton-only. Do not use for onboarding to other chains or tools. Ask the user's background first (EVM, Solana, Sui/Move, Web, Enterprise, or New to Blockchain). Prefer this over 'search' for 'how to build / get started on Canton'; use get_faq for a single specific gotcha and get_api_reference for API details.
